texts.en:
Technology continues to progress on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], as industrialization takes their society to new heights. Their most recent breakthrough in engineering has revolutionized their use of transportation and brought them a step closer to planetary unification.

Defying our prediction models, [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] is now a unified world. Pooling their resources, the people have prioritized the wellbeing of the global community and living standards are rising.

texts.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]科学技术得到了进一步的发展，因为工业化使他们的社会达到了新的高度。他们在工程方面的最新突破彻底改变了他们对交通的运用，这使他们离行星统一更近了一步。

[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民们齐心协力，建设出了一个团结的星球。他们统一调配行星资源，每个蜂巢都将整个星球社区的共同利益放在首位，他们集体的生活水平超乎寻常。
texts.en:
Technology continues to progress on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], as industrialization takes their society to new heights. Their most recent breakthrough in engineering has revolutionized their use of transportation and brought them a step closer to planetary unification.

Working together, the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have built a unified industrial world. Pooling world resources, the individual hives have prioritized the wellbeing of the entire global community, and their collective living standards appear exceptional.

label.zh: 他们拥有的资源比实际需要的要多……
label.en: They have more resources than they need...

tooltips.zh: 我们可以帮助他们缓解资源过多的问题。
tooltips.en: We could alleviate them of some of their resources.

texts.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的生活正在蓬勃发展，繁荣的经济为我们提供了一些……千载难逢的机会。一个新近建造的陆路货运网络就是一个理想的目标。从理论上讲，我们的特工人员可以很容易地登上这些货车，夺取货物。然而，根据我们目前的观测姿态，我们必须要采取额外的预防措施，以保持不被更多人发现。
texts.en: Life on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] is thriving, and the booming economy offers us certain... unique opportunities. A newly constructed network of land freighters is an ideal target. In theory, our operatives could easily board one of these freighters and seize the cargo. However, in accordance with our current observation stance, we would have to take extra precautions to remain undetected by the wider population.

label.zh: 停下。我们除了研究别无其他需求。
label.en: Stand down. We require nothing from them but research.

texts.zh: [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的货物打劫行动是一场成功。我们的特工夺得了一小部分合金，同时在下面的时候还学到了很多有关[GetPreFTLLower]转运的知识。
texts.en: The cargo heist on [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] was a success. Our agents secured a small cache of alloys, and learned a lot about [GetPreFTLLower] transit while they were down there.

texts.zh: [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的货物打劫行动宣告失败。我们的特工在某艘陆地货船上的行动中惨遭抓获。在接下来的冲突中，双方都遭受了伤亡，我们的特工身份暴露。
texts.en: The cargo heist on [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] was a failure. Our operatives were apprehended mid-operation aboard a land freighter. During the ensuing altercation, casualties were recorded on both sides, and our agents were exposed.
